en: Colorized winter scene of snow-covered buildings on a hillside. A large striped spherical weather ball hangs in the foreground with the German greeting "Frohes Neujahr!" written across it. Two men in early-20th‑century clothing stand near the small building beneath the ball. At the top-left, printed text identifies the location as the weather ball and fortress at Schlossberg in Graz.
